title: Presolana window: bounded traverse with threshold inside the climb
terrain: alpine, 900-1100m D+ continuous, D- capped 1100m, non-technical descent line

steps.target: keep climbing easy, 75-84% LTHR, never descend or stand still
Z2 continuous climb to the high point, 152-161 bpm
Z1-Z2 descent, poles, short strides, cadence 175+

coachNotes: Wednesday is now the only guaranteed mountain day of the week and the only descent terrain before 5-6 September, so Thursday's quality session moves into it. Do not turn that into a reason to go bigger. ROUTE BRIEF: 900-1100m D+ in one continuous ascent, descent matched and hard-capped at 1100m, no sustained grade steeper than -12%, descent line runnable at cadence 175+ (rocky step-down braking terrain is the ITB failure mode, not the length). Loop or point-to-point both fine. WEATHER: ARPA has convection from Wednesday evening, so off any exposed crest by 15:00 and start by 06:00, which also handles the heat. Expect 15-18C at 2500m, not the 11C mountain-forecast is showing, with 35C in the valley; carry 2.5L minimum, limestone in August gives back everything it absorbs. ITB: this is the first real descent in 17 days, Valbondione on 2 August was the last one. That gap is the risk, not the gradient. Poles from the first metre of descent, no free-running the steep upper section, and any lateral knee signal means walk out and Saturday drops to the bike. Garmin on-watch load expect 200-260 against the intervals.icu 120.
